item.description:
✔️ Bladeless Fan
There will be no ordinary ceiling fan and the flash frequency/shadow effect, the wind speed mimics the natural wind, air conditioning blowing system, the wind blowing will not give people a headache, 6 gears can be adjusted wind speed, to meet your daily needs

✔️ LED Tri-Color Light + Infinitely Dimmable
All our models come with a high quality light source LED tri-color light kit. You can easily change the color tone using the remote control. That's because the tri-color LED lights come in Daylight, Warm White and Cool White. Infinitely dimmable is more ergonomic than traditional lights and allows you to adjust the color temperature and brightness of the light source, making it more suitable for home use.

✔️ Nano sterilization
Purifies air, sterilizes and disinfects, remves formaldehyde and other household germs.

✔️ Air Purification
The product is equipped with air purification function, whch automatically purifies the air when the fan is turned on, bringing healthy air to your home.

✔️ 120w Natural Light
Anti-flicker/anti-blue light/illumination > 300 Lux / CQS> 97 / CRI> 97 Protect your eyesight health, school classroom level light source to protect your eyes from fatigue, high saturation to restore the true colors.

✔️6 Adjustable wind speed by flap
1-2 Breeze / 3-4 Medium wind / 5-6 Strong wind

✔️ DC Motor 

Can't sleep because of the sound of a fan spinning at high sped? DC mtors are much quieter than AC motors. As a result, you get a better night's sleep. In adition, they use at least 50% less energy than AC motors. This in turn reduces your electricity bill.
Voltage: 220V
Power consumption class: 1 (low)

✔️ with remote control
All of our models come with a remote control tht allows you to set the fan speed or LED lights for comfort. Whether you're sitting on the couch watching TV or lying in bed getting ready for bed, the remote can be placed within your reach to control the fan's operation.

✔️ About Maintenance
This bladeless ceiling fan light is made with air condtioner vents, so the vnts are dust and mosquito proof, which can be kept clean for a long time, you only need to clean it once a year. Simple and convnient.

✔️ Local Warranty.
Don't be afraid! We ship locally for local warranty, so you can contact us for any after-sale questions. 5 years free warranty on the motor!
